newsitem.title: USA: PriCellular, NYNEX in interconnection deal.
newsitem.headline: PriCellular, NYNEX in interconnection deal.

text.p: PriCellular Corp said on Tuesday it reached a agreement with NYNEX Corp to exchange voice traffic between their networks, a deal that could reduce PriCellular's interconnection charges in New York by more than 60 percent.

If approved by the New York State Public Service Commission, the arrangement would significantly reduce PriCellular's rates for calls that terminate on NYNEX's network, the company said in a news release.
NYNEX would compensate PriCellular reciprocally for calls that terminate on PriCellular's network.
PriCellular owns and operates cellular phone systems, mostly in the Midwest and in New York.
